step.action: 核对十一宫（Labh）是否被木星（Guru）占据，并核对二宫（Dhan）与九宫（Dharm）是否分别被月亮（Chandra）与金星（Shukra）占据。
step.applicability_scope: 仅限本命盘十一宫（Labh）收获主题；原文三个落宫是并列前提，且二宫对月亮、九宫对金星的对应次序由原文 respectively 定死；原文未给应期。
step.minimum_supported_claim: 十一宫被木星占据，二宫与九宫分别被月亮和金星按落宫占据时，本人拥有6000 Nishkas。
produced_fact_keys: 木星落十一宫6000 Nishkas判定

conditions.quote: Labh Bhava is occupied by Guru
Dhan Bhava and Dharm Bhava are, respectively, taken over by Chandra and Shukra by position
conditions.claim: 二宫与九宫分别被月亮和金星按落宫占据

evidence_refs.quote: The native will own 6000 Nishkas, if Labh Bhava is occupied by Guru, while Dhan Bhava and Dharm Bhava are, respectively, taken over by Chandra and Shukra by position.

step.stop_condition: 缺少以下固定事实即停止：木星（Guru）是否落十一宫（Labh）、月亮（Chandra）是否落二宫（Dhan）、金星（Shukra）是否落九宫（Dharm）。
forbidden_extensions: 不得把月亮与金星的落宫对调：原文 respectively 已定死二宫配月亮、九宫配金星。
不得把 6000 Nishkas 换算成任何现代货币金额，也不得据此推断应期。

bphs-97:santhanam:ch21:v19-21.exact_text: 19-21. Combinations for Fame. One will be endowed with fame, if Chandra is in Karm Bhava, while Karm’s Lord is in a trine from Karm Bhava and Lagn’s Lord is in Lagn’s angle. Similar effects will come to pass, if Labh’s Lord is in Karm Bhava, while Karm’s Lord is strong and gives a Drishti to Guru. Fame will come to the native, if Karm’s Lord is in Dharm Bhava, as Lagn’s Lord is in Karm Bhava and Chandra is in Putr Bhava.
